name: ACCT 5543
title: Advanced Assurance Services
description: Advanced treatment of significant assurance services issues. Intended for students with previous coursework in assurance services and/or auditing. The course demonstrates more detailed level of audit techniques: audit planning, risk analysis, assessing internal control, executing audit procedures to substantiate validity of key financial accounts, and a presenting the audit findings in a final audit report.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
